question: In which state was the ‘Portable Transit Hospital Structure’ inaugurated in November 2020 by the Union Health Minister Dr Harsh Vardhan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Union Health Minister Dr Harsh Vardhan on Wednesday inaugurated the** "Portable Transit Hospital Structure"** at National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) **4th Bn Station Arakkonam, in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• "The features of Prefabricated Isolation Centre include:
 
 
• It can be ready in very less time.
 
• It is very light and can be easily moved from one place to another.
 
• It is completely safe and it is safe from the environment's point of view.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harsh Vardhan** is an Indian** otorhinolaryngologist.**
 
• He had served as the Minister of Health and Family Welfare, Minister of Science and Technology and Minister of Earth Sciences in the BJP-led NDA government of Prime Minister Narendra Modi from** 30 May 2019 to 7 July 2021. **
